note: Source-only review prompts written from this repository's own project projection and model-coupling report. They are not challenges by reviewers, not new findings and not biological observations. Replace them with Project records and real annotations when the node serves them.
meaning: A design review is an authored, falsifiable challenge attached to one exact Project version. It is not a vote, consensus score, answer, scientific adjudication or project resolution. A reply does not change the challenged Project.

source_prompts.title: Fin-beam load bridge is scenario-level
source_prompts.observation: The organ panel calls the fin-beam model a scoped elastic surrogate. docs/model-coupling.md marks the load-to-beam bridge scenario-level: mean lift-pressure proxy times a declared tributary width, a declared ray-length fraction and an assumed EI. There is no calibrated fin stiffness or measured ray pressure.
source_prompts.ask: Which loading regime and measured stiffness would falsify this bridge?

source_prompts.title: Notch/Delta to fin stiffness is refused
source_prompts.observation: The coupling report refuses the Collier Notch/Delta to fin-stiffness bridge: there is no mapping, and the transfer spans cell-to-organ and taxon contexts.
source_prompts.ask: What exact, context-matched developmental or tissue measurement would be required before this counts as a biological bridge?

source_prompts.title: Zebrafish interaction phenocopies fin proportion; transfer to halfbeaks unestablished
source_prompts.observation: The Daane 2021 zebrafish interaction phenocopies flying-fish fin proportion, but transfer to halfbeaks is unestablished and no developmental model connects adult proportions to a program.
source_prompts.ask: Which test separates correlation from the asserted genotype-to-fin pathway, with exact source and model pins?

source_prompts.title: Glide release convention drives much of the range
source_prompts.observation: The glide report uses a release at 1.5 times stall speed from 1 m, equivalent to release heights from about 1.8 m to 32.6 m. It says this convention drives much of the range and is a model artifact.
source_prompts.ask: Compare a sourced fixed-speed or fixed-height release; what observable would reject either?

general_prompts.text: Identify which measured animal, life stage and loading regime justify the modeled fin stiffness; if none is pinned, say unknown and propose a test.
Challenge a ray-to-fin mapping at a specific Project member and cite an exact mesh or source record; say whether the geometry is measured, reconstructed or illustrative.
Separate a level-flight lift constraint from glide and sink predictions; name the regime and the evidence that would falsify the proxy.
Require an exact developmental or genetic Evidence pin before treating a morphology correlation as a causal genotype-to-fin link.
State print material, orientation, minimum feature size and a physical test that could reject the design claim.

prompts_note: These are dimensions to inspect. They do not assert that the current Project has any particular flaw.
